nonblocking_findings.title: Local launcher and observer require the intended Python 3.11 runner
evidence: Local default python inspected during review is E:/anaconda/python.exe 3.7.6
nonblocking_findings.impact: Using shell-default Python 3.7 would fail locally before SSH; remote Python3.7 execution is unaffected.
nonblocking_findings.minimal_action: Invoke both through the existing local Python3.11 credential runner. No compatibility fallback is required.

resolved_findings.title: Deployment omitted required model and parser assets
original_evidence: Initial manifest/archive omitted class embeddings, mapping JSON and four parser text files
resolved_findings.repair: The manifest includes the five local parser assets. REMOTE_ASSETS supplies the retained class-embedding and PointNet paths; launcher checks/copies them for CPU and verifies staged assets at every later stage.

verified_source_properties: MCLN change is limited to three attributes and a single forward-tail adapter call; original baseline body otherwise matches.
E71 initialization removes exactly nine SourceChoice states and requires the exact 1135-state core before strict load; portable A/B use strict loads and explicit 27841/29793 parameter checks.
A receives mask-query Bx256x288 and support288xSP; B receives pre-mask decoder queries of the same feature dimension. These endpoints match native forward definitions.
Four portable source modules match their supplied origins byte-for-byte. No PV six-source G path or extra Face branch is installed.
Prediction geometry reads points, predicted masks, native boxes, query/support features and prediction-derived validity. Dataset GT is attached after forward and used for native loss/evaluation only.
Validation uses native Joint3DDataset val split and asserts 9508 rows; native/Mask/full branches deep-copy the same once-read batch and restore Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG before each branch.
Evaluation calls the existing native loss and GroundingEvaluator. Corrected row scoring follows native bbs parse/term-order/default-query-axis ranking, with final integer-hit equivalence checks.

model.eval and torch.no_grad are used; no optimizer or checkpoint writing exists in the replay. A complete 1159-state equality assertion and identical native semantic-score assertion are required before RESULT.

Sanity/full require successful preceding actual stage, completed BN diagnostic, empty compute-app admission and the existing serial flock; controller launches one child and records child exit/results.
SSH destination, host-key witness and private askpass route are explicit. The observer only checks existing process identities and reads status/log/result files after its supplied due time.
All 736 packaged files match the manifest. 121 packaged core/entry sources and both embedded remote bodies parse under actual Python 3.7.6.
semantic_review_scope: Requested core files, plan/spec/manifest, launcher/controller/observer, relevant native loss/factory/dataset/evaluator/forward/import/asset paths; other packaged files received byte or syntax checks only.
limitations: This is a source-only code review, not an experiment-integrity audit or a GPU/accuracy pass.
Remote asset existence and bytes, E71/checkpoint payload contents, actual import/factory compatibility and memory use require the next actual CPU/runtime stages.
The reviewer has not attested model backend identity or cross-family independence.
Direct PV-trained288-dimensional A/B transfer effectiveness on MCLN is unmeasured; this is not MCLN adaptation training.
next_permitted_action: Run the actual CPU factory/core/portable-state stage via the existing local Python3.11 credential runner; only actual success may admit8row GPU sanity, and only successful sanity may admit full9508.
